release_gates: Every portrait has distinct high quality source+Android resource+renderer mapping and 30/48/72dp previews
Every board registers a contrast-tested palette covering selected, related, partner, matching, conflict, proof, pencil notes and dark/light states
Every font is a documented redistribution-licensed bundled static face and has legible distinct digits 1–9 in real grid/notes
No game rules, default progression, existing IDs, thresholds or owned status changed
Completed-puzzle milestones remain deduplicated, count SOLO DAILY COOP and VERSUS WIN and show accurate progress
Newly earned ownership survives record pruning and JSON backup/restore with legacy saves
Multi-device missing/unknown new IDs fall back safely; two-phone LAN smoke
Android API26–36 validation and actual phone/capture review
Real Beta 1→Beta 2 update must use original production certificate, higher version code and save-preserving install-over; never replace signed public game with reviewer build

art_direction.canonical_style: GridMates Collection character portrait house style; flat chibi shape language and restrained shading
art_direction.repeat_policy: Repeat species only with documented family/ecological justification and visually distinct breed/pose/markings/silhouette while preserving house style; never simply recolor the same sprite.
art_direction.avoid: painterly faces, glow/fringe halos, photo-real texture, extra limb/detail, inconsistent eyes or outline
